decisions.statement: The first account key beginning with an at sign supplies the characters.
A character with no build hash is left out.
A character with no name is named for the game's number for that character.
A build hash that will not decode is skipped and the rest are still imported.
A tree with fewer than four slotted champion stars is filled out with its own no-star.
A skill line the catalog does not name is dropped before the hash is re-encoded.
Every imported character is re-encoded as having no ESO Plus.
The account page is upserted before any character page.
A saved-variables file naming no character writes no page.

definition: the characters a saved-variables file holds, re-encoded onto account character pages
